'''Jubilar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] used as a penal colony by half a dozen of its neighboring worlds, resulting in many civil wars throughout its history. The thriving [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trade within this planet's [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].

[[Death (town)|Dying Slowly]] was one notable town on the planet, which included an entertainment venue called the [[Victory Forum]]. The ''[[Regional Sector Number Four's All-Human Free-For-All]]'' was a popular fighting event held there. On the edge of the city existed a slum known as [[Executioner's Row]].

[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] visited this planet while chasing a bounty in [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]]; it was here that he had his first encounter, albeit indirect, with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was a combatant in the Free-For-All. At that time, Solo's identity was unknown to Fett.

Fett returned to the planet in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] hunting Solo. Tracking down the former smuggler with the help of an old contact, they faced off, before settling their decades long feud peacefully, both older and less angry than in the past.
